title: The costume library
paragraphs: The drama room had become so {{1}} that students could barely reach the costume shelves. Boxes from several productions had been returned without any order.
Farah {{2}} turning the room into a costume library. Her team {{3}} each box by size and period, then repaired several {{4}} hats before storing them safely.

At first, a blue jacket seemed to have been lost. Another group had placed it beside the curtains, and the actors were {{5}} when it was recovered. By the next rehearsal, every borrowed item could be traced on a simple checkout sheet.
